title: Dashboard
stepQuickDesc: Tick what you want: a home screen that answers "Alexa", Meta's Alexa, a clean-up.
stepCleanupDesc: Clear caches and remove the Meta apps you no longer use.
step2Desc: Video, music, games and much more.
installAppsDesc: Browse the catalog and add more apps to your Portal
cleanupDesc: Free storage and memory: app caches and unused Meta apps
cleanupIntro: Meta apps are only removed for your user: they stay in the system and can be put back at any time.
cleanupCachesHint: Safe: apps rebuild them when needed

quick.title: Quick setup
quick.desc: Home screen with hands-free Alexa, Meta's Alexa and clean-up, in one go
quick.intro: Tick what you want on this Portal, then start. Things already installed are left unticked; tick them to reinstall or update.
quick.doneHint: Say "Alexa" in front of the home screen.
quick.signIn: On the Portal, Alexa shows a code: enter it at amazon.com/code to sign in.

home.title: Portal Accueil home screen
home.hint: Clock, weather and your apps, and it hears "Alexa" without touching anything. Replaces Réveil Alexa.

cleanup.title: Clean up the Portal
cleanup.hint: Clears app caches and removes unused Meta apps (WhatsApp, Meta photo frame, Portal feed, Story Time, Photo editor). They can be restored.

alexa.title: Meta's Alexa
alexa.hint: The Portal's original Alexa (115 MB), signed in with amazon.com/code. Needed for "Alexa" to answer.

quick.legacy: This Portal runs Android 9 (1st generation): Meta's Alexa with its own "Hey Alexa" can be restored. Install Immortal and tick "Restore Amazon Alexa" in its setup.
